title: Meta strikes up to $100B AMD chip deal as it chases ‘personal superintelligence’
description: Meta is buying billions of dollars in AMD AI chips in a multiyear deal tied to a 160 million-share warrant, deepening its push to diversify beyond Nvidia and expand data center capacity.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Oura launches a proprietary AI model focused on women’s health
description: The model supports questions spanning the full reproductive health spectrum, from early menstrual cycles through menopause.
author: Aisha Malik

title: Final 4 days to save up to $680 on your TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 pass
description: Just 4 days left before savings of up to $680 on your TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 pass end on February 27 at 11:59 p.m. PT. Register to save at one of the most anticipated tech events of the year.
author: TechCrunch Events

title: Anthropic launches new push for enterprise agents with plugins for finance, engineering, and design
description: It's a major opportunity to grow Anthropic’s enterprise client base — and a significant threat to SaaS products currently performing those functions.
author: Russell Brandom

title: New Relic launches new AI agent platform and OpenTelemetry tools
description: New Relic is giving enterprises more observability tools, letting them create and manage AI agents, and better integrate OTel data streams.
author: Rebecca Szkutak

title: Nimble raises $47M to give AI agents access to real-time web data
description: Nimble uses AI agents to search the web, verify and validate the results, and then clean and structure the information into neat tables that can then be queried like a database.
author: Ram Iyer

title: Canva acquires startups working on animation and marketing
description: With the new acquisitions, the company wants to bolster its position as a marketing solution by potentially adding video creation and more granular measurement.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: A Meta AI security researcher said an OpenClaw agent ran amok on her inbox
description: The viral X post from an AI security researcher reads like satire. But it's really a word of warning about what can go wrong when handing tasks to an AI agent.
author: Julie Bort

title: With AI, investor loyalty is (almost) dead: At least a dozen OpenAI VCs now also back Anthropic
description: While some dual investors are understandable, others were more shocking, and signal the disregard of a longstanding ethical conflict-of-interest rule.
author: Julie Bort

title: Anthropic accuses Chinese AI labs of mining Claude as US debates AI chip exports
description: Anthropic accuses DeepSeek, Moonshot, and MiniMax of using 24,000 fake accounts to distill Claude’s AI capabilities, as U.S. officials debate export controls aimed at slowing China’s AI progress.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Google’s Cloud AI lead on the three frontiers of model capability
description: AI models are pushing against three frontiers at once: raw intelligence, response time, and a third quality you might call "extensibility."
author: Russell Brandom

title: OpenAI calls in the consultants for its enterprise push
description: OpenAI is partnering with four consulting giants in an effort to see more adoption of its OpenAI Frontier AI agent platform.
author: Rebecca Szkutak

title: Guide Labs debuts a new kind of interpretable LLM
description: The company open sourced an 8-billion-parameter LLM, Steerling-8B, trained with a new architecture designed to make its actions easily interpretable.
author: Tim Fernholz

title: Particle’s AI news app listens to podcasts for interesting clips so you you don’t have to
description: AI news app Particle can now pull in key moments from podcasts, letting readers instantly play short, relevant clips alongside related stories.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Spotify rolls out AI-powered  Prompted Playlists to the UK and other markets
description: Spotify continues to test its AI-powered “Prompted Playlist” feature, now rolling out the tool to Premium subscribers in the U.K., Ireland, Australia, and Sweden.
author: Lauren Forristal

title: 5 days left to lock in the lowest TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 ticket rates
description: Five days to save up to $680 on your TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 ticket. These lowest rates of the year disappear on February 27 at 11:59 p.m. PT.
author: TechCrunch Events

title: How AI agents could destroy the economy
description: Citrini Research imagines a report from two years in the future, in which unemployment has doubled and the total value of the stock market has fallen by more than a third.
author: Russell Brandom

title: Defense Secretary summons Anthropic’s Amodei over military use of Claude
description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth has summoned Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei to the Pentagon for a tense discussion over the military's use of Claude. Hegseth has threatened to designate Anthropic a "supply chain risk."
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: All the important news from the ongoing India AI Impact Summit
description: India is hosting a four-day AI Summit this week that will be attended by executives from major AI labs and Big Tech, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Nvidia, Microsoft, Google, and Cloudflare, as well as heads of state.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: 6 days left to lock in the lowest TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 rates
description: Super Early Bird pricing for TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 ends February 27 at 11:59 p.m. PT. That means you have just 6 days left to secure up to $680 of ticket savings.
author: TechCrunch Events

title: Sam Altman would like remind you that humans use a lot of energy, too
description: "It also takes a lot of energy to train a human."
author: Anthony Ha

title: Microsoft’s new gaming CEO vows not to flood the ecosystem with ‘endless AI slop’
description: Is Microsoft's gaming division doubling down on AI?
author: Anthony Ha

title: Google VP warns that two types of AI startups may not survive
description: As generative AI evolves, a Google VP warns that LLM wrappers and AI aggregators face mounting pressure, with shrinking margins and limited differentiation threatening their long-term viability.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: OpenAI debated calling police about suspected Canadian shooter’s chats
description: Jesse Van Rootselaar's descriptions of gun violence were flagged by tools that monitor ChatGPT for misuse.
author: Tim Fernholz

title: 7 days until ticket prices rise for TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
description: Lowest ticket prices to TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 end February 27. Up to $680 off individual passes and up to 30% off group passes. Register before they go up to join 10,000 founders, tech operators, and VCs.
author: TechCrunch Events

title: India’s Sarvam launches Indus AI chat app as competition heats up
description: Sarvam's Indus chat app is currently available in beta.
author: Jagmeet Singh

title: The creator economy’s ad revenue problem and India’s AI ambitions
description: The creator economy is evolving fast, and ad revenue alone isn’t cutting it anymore. YouTubers are launching product lines, acquiring startups, and building actual business empires. In fact, MrBeast’s company bought fintech startup Step, and his chocolate business is outearning his media arm. This isn’t just one creator’s strategy. For many, it’s the new playbook.  On this episode of TechCrunch’s Equity podcast, hosts Kirsten Korosec, Anthony Ha, and Rebecca Bellan unpack how creators are diversifying beyond ads, […]
author: Theresa Loconsolo

title: Why creators are ditching ad revenue for chocolate bars and fintech acquisitions
description: The creator economy is evolving fast, and ad revenue alone isn’t cutting it anymore. YouTubers are launching product lines, acquiring startups, and building actual business empires. In fact, MrBeast’s company bought fintech startup Step, and his chocolate business is out-earning his media arm. This isn’t just one creator’s strategy. For many, it’s the new playbook.  […]

title: Anthropic-funded group backs candidate attacked by rival AI super PAC
description: Dueling pro-AI PACs have centered around backing or targeting one New York congressional bid: Alex Bores, whose RAISE Act requires AI developers to disclose safety protocols and report serious system misuse.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: InScope nabs $14.5M to solve the pain of financial reporting
description: The startup, founded by accountants who worked at Flexport, Miro, Hopin and Thrive Global, automates the difficulties of prepping financial statements.
author: Marina Temkin
